INSERT INTO ssq_draw (issue, red_1, red_2, red_3, red_4, red_5, red_6, blue, draw_date) VALUES
(#{d.issue}, #{d.red1}, #{d.red2}, #{d.red3}, #{d.red4}, #{d.red5}, #{d.red6}, #{d.blue}, #{d.drawDate})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM ssq_draw WHERE issue = #{issue} LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM ssq_draw ORDER BY draw_date DESC, issue DESC LIMIT 1
